OrderBump_Product_Deleted_Help: The product for this offer was deleted. Open this bump and choose another product to make the offer work again.
OrderBump_Position_Help: Offers with the same position are shown together. Offers left on Default stay under the order notes.
OrderBump_Preview_Hidden: This order bump is disabled on checkout, so customers will not see it.
Addon_Addon_Assets: Addon assets allow you to distribute additional downloadable packages (e.g., payment gateway addons) that share this product's license.
Bump_Optionally_Add: Optionally add a description that will get your customers excited about the offer. You can use html as well.
Coupon_Choose_Min: Choose what the min/max spend limits are measured against: the cart subtotal (items only) or the order total (including shipping and fees). Applies at checkout.
Coupon_Coupons_Calculated: Coupons will be calculated based on their priority. The lower the number the higher the priority is.
Coupon_List_Email: List of email addresses that can use the coupon. Separate multiple emails with commas. You may also use regular expressions.
Coupon_Mark_Coupon: Mark this coupon as recurring to apply it automatically to every future subscription order. This discount will automatically apply on every renewal. However, the coupon will not be applied if it reduces the payable amount to zero.
Coupon_Maximum_Logged: Maximum an logged in user can use. 0 means unlimited. Only logged in user can use this coupon.
CouponRpt_Compare_Customers: Compare customers won with a coupon against those who paid full price, and see each coupon's refund rate and what its customers are worth.
CouponRpt_Discount_Given: Discount given as a share of what the coupon orders would have cost at full price.
CouponRpt_New_Customers: New customers in this period, split by whether their first purchase used a coupon, and what they have been worth since.
CouponRpt_New_Customers_Counts: New Customers counts first purchases, as on the Customers report. Discount Rate is the discount divided by what the orders would have cost at full price. Value of Customers Won is what the customers a coupon won have spent with you to date, each. Refund Rate counts orders refunded in part or full.
CouponRpt_Orders_Coupon: Orders with a coupon discount but no coupon code recorded, for example renewal discounts imported from another platform. Not in the rows or totals above.
Customer_Confirmed_Person: Only do this if you confirmed that this person owns %1$s. Guest orders on this email will be linked to this customer.
CustomerRpt_Customers_Bought: Customers who had bought before and made a new purchase in this period. Renewals alone do not count.
CustomerRpt_Customers_Paid: Of the customers who paid in this period, the share who have made two or more purchases. Renewals are not purchases.
CustomerRpt_Customers_Paid_Period: What the customers who paid in this period have spent with you over all time, less refunds and tax, on average.
CustomerRpt_Customers_Whose: Customers whose first purchase was in this period. A renewal is never a first purchase.
CustomerRpt_Group_Customers: Group customers by how recently, how often and how much they buy, so you know who to thank and who to win back.
CustomerRpt_Paid_Period: Who paid in each period: new customers, customers who bought again, and customers who only renewed.
CustomerRpt_See_Lifetime: See the lifetime value of each month's new customers, and how much of your revenue depends on your top customers.
CustomerRpt_See_Many: See how many purchases each customer makes, and how long they take to buy again.
CustomerRpt_Share_Period: The share of this period's revenue from customers who had bought before: their new purchases and renewals.
Download_Deleting_Asset: Deleting this asset will break the download link in existing purchase emails. To update the file, edit the asset instead of deleting it.
Export_Authentication_Hashes: Authentication hashes, payment tokens, and other credentials are excluded or redacted from JSON exports.
Export_Browser_Prepares: This browser prepares the final download in memory. For very large exports, use a Chromium-based browser for direct-to-disk writing.
Export_Export_Configurable: Export configurable CSV files or schema-rich JSON data directly from your browser.
Export_Export_Exceeds: This export exceeds the 64 MB safe in-memory limit. Use a Chromium-based browser to write the file directly to disk.
GatewayRpt_Declined_Charges: Declined charges the gateway recorded in this period. Some gateways, such as PayPal, record none.
GatewayRpt_Monthly_Recurring: Monthly recurring revenue of the failing subscriptions, as on the Subscriptions report.
GatewayRpt_Monthly_Recurring_Revenue: Monthly recurring revenue of the subscriptions whose renewal payment is failing today. The date range does not apply.
GatewayRpt_Paid_Orders: Paid orders out of paid orders and the declined charges the gateway recorded. Some gateways, such as PayPal, retry on their side and record no declines.
GatewayRpt_See_Disputed: See disputed orders and lost disputes by payment method, and which cards and wallets your customers use.
GatewayRpt_Subscriptions_Whose: Subscriptions whose renewal payment is failing today, by the payment method they renew with. The date range does not apply.
Gross_Gross_Volume: %1$s gross volume was %2$s, %3$s. With %4$s days left in %5$s, Gross volume is %6$s for the quarter, %7$s and %8$s
Gross_Gross_Volume_Gross: %1$s gross volume was %2$s, %3$s. Gross volume for the month of %4$s so far is %5$s. Here's the trend over the previous 12 months.
Integration_Configure_Integrations: Configure your integrations and extend FluentCart to enhance your store's functionality.
Integration_Don_Integration: You don't have any integration module enabled. Please go to integration modules and enable and configured from available modules
Integration_Integration_Feeds: These integration feeds will be applied globally across all your orders and related actions.
Inventory_Stock_Management: Stock Management module is currently disabled. Please enable it in %1$smodule settings%2$s to use inventory features.
License_Licensing_Module: The Licensing module is turned off. Turn it on in Settings → Features & addon to manage licenses.
License_Licensing_Now: Licensing now ships with FluentCart Pro v%s or later. Ask a site administrator to update FluentCart Pro.
License_Licensing_Now_Ships: Licensing now ships with FluentCart Pro v%s or later. Update FluentCart Pro to keep managing licenses and activated sites.
LocationRpt_Holds_Country: %1$s holds most of this country's orders. That is often a checkout default rather than real demand, so check the address settings before reading it as a trend.
LocationRpt_Net_Sales: Net sales from outside %1$s, the store country in the store settings, as a share of all net sales.
LocationRpt_Open_Country: Open any country to see its states and cities, what customers from each place are worth, and which places grow or decline.
LocationRpt_Order_Placed: Each order is placed by its latest address. With a product filter, the money is those products' share of each order.
LocationRpt_Orders_Without: Orders without an address of their own: %1$s placed by their original order (renewals), %2$s by the customer's country (country only).
LocationRpt_Share_New: Share of the new customers won here who made a second purchase. Renewals do not count.
Mcp_Create_Application: Create an application password for your WordPress user, then fill it in below. Your password stays in the browser — it is only written into the snippet you copy.
Mcp_Fluentcart_Speaks: FluentCart speaks to AI agents through the MCP adapter bundled with FluentHub (WordPress 6.9+). The endpoint will not respond until it is installed and active.
Mcp_Hub_Intro_Admin: Add this URL to your AI app and sign in with your WordPress account. There is no password to copy, and the same URL gives the app your other Fluent plugins.
Mcp_Hub_Intro_User: Add this URL to your AI app and sign in with your WordPress account. There is no password to copy.
Mcp_Hub_Off_Intro: FluentHub can give AI apps one URL for this site, with sign-in through WordPress and no password to copy. Its MCP server is off.
Mcp_Hub_Reason_App_Passwords: Sign-in needs application passwords, which are switched off on this site. They need HTTPS, and a security plugin can turn them off.
Mcp_Hub_Turn_On_Note: This makes every Fluent plugin that has MCP switched on reachable through one URL, for site administrators and the users each plugin allows. It also lets AI apps register themselves and ask a user to sign in. To turn it off again, use FluentHub.
Mcp_Hub_Turn_On_Plugin: Connected AI apps can then read and change this plugin's data, for the users the plugin allows. To turn a plugin off, use FluentHub.
Mcp_Hub_Who: Site administrators can use this URL for every Fluent plugin. Store users with a FluentCart role can use it for FluentCart.
NotFound_Check_Url: Please check the URL and try again, or use the search bar to find what you need.
Onboard_Import_Stopped: The import stopped early. Products created before it stopped were kept, and you can add the rest from the Products page.
Onboard_Products_Created: The products that were created have been kept. You can add the rest from the Products page.
Onboard_Standard_Tax: A standard tax class will be created for %1$s. Add your rates in Tax → Tax Rates after setup.
Onboard_Standard_Tax_Class: A standard tax class will be created. Add your rates in Tax → Tax Rates after setup.
Order_Account_Changed: The account changed its email without an inbox check. Verify it from the customer profile.
Order_Carrier_Did: The carrier did not confirm this label. Check the carrier dashboard, then click Mark resolved before buying again.
Order_Carrier_Did_Confirm: The carrier did not confirm this label. Click Check again to look it up before buying again.
Order_Close_Refresh: Please do not close or refresh this window. Please wait while we delete the selected orders...
Order_Create_New: We will create a new user for this customer. If a user with the same email already exists, we will associate the customer with that existing user.
Order_Delete_Shipment: Delete this shipment? Its %1$s label will be voided, and the carrier refunds it if eligible.
Order_Did_Confirm: %s did not confirm a label bought for this order. Check the carrier dashboard before buying again.
Order_Dispute_Refundable: This dispute has refundable action, so you may refund the charge to the customer for a dispute resolution.
Order_Either_Counter: You may either counter the dispute by providing evidence to prove that the cardholder is the legitimate purchaser, or you can accept this dispute immediately to refund the cardholder and close the dispute.
Order_Every_Item: Every item, coupon and the total will be re-priced in %1$s. Custom prices are kept as typed, not converted.
Order_Mark_Purchase: Mark this purchase resolved? Do this only after you checked the carrier dashboard.
Order_Response_Received: No response received. Check the order transactions before retrying: the refund may already be recorded.
Order_Server_Stopped: The server stopped before it confirmed this shipment. Reload the order before trying again.
Order_Set_Possible: If set, possible values are duplicate fraudulent, and requested_by_customer If you believe the charge to be fraudulent, specifying fraudulent as the reason will add the associated card and email to your block lists
Order_Sure_Want: Are you sure you want to change the order status to Cancel? This action is irreversible and cannot be undone.
Order_Timeout_Check: If this was a timeout, check the %1$s dashboard first. The refund may already be there.
Order_Unit_Price: Unit price is rounded for display. The line total is calculated at full precision.
Order_Vendor_Checkout: Vendor checkout will redirect to vendor payment page instead of default payment page!
OrderRpt_Find_Busiest: Find your busiest days and hours, typical order sizes and how long orders take to complete.
OrderRpt_Net_Sales: Net sales divided by orders, by period, as the Average Order Value card counts it.
OrderRpt_New_Customer: New: the customer's first paid purchase, as on the Customers report. Returning: the customer had paid before. Renewal: subscription renewals. Installment payment: later payments of an installment plan. Free order: nothing was paid. Guest: orders without a customer account.
OrderRpt_Orders_Created: Orders created in this period whose payment failed. Not counted in the other cards.
OrderRpt_Orders_Orders: The orders in the Orders card, split by type, status and discount. Each split adds up to that card.
OrderRpt_Paid_Partially: Paid, partially paid and refunded orders created in this period, in the report currency. Renewal orders are included; unpaid orders are not.
OverviewRpt_Active_Subscriptions: Active subscriptions, discounted first years, and canceled subscriptions still in their paid term.
OverviewRpt_Customers_Paid: What customers paid in this period, less refunds and tax, as on the Revenue report.
OverviewRpt_Dispute_Rate: The dispute rate is %1$s, above the %2$s at which card networks start to monitor a store.
OverviewRpt_Monthly_Recurring: Monthly recurring revenue now, as on the Subscriptions report. The date range does not apply.
OverviewRpt_Net_Sales: Net sales by month, against the same month a year earlier. The current month is not over yet. The date range does not apply.
OverviewRpt_Subscriptions_Ended: Subscriptions that ended in this period, as a share of those active at its start, as on the Subscriptions report.
Pricing_Dynamic_Pricing: Dynamic Pricing module is currently disabled. Please enable it in %1$smodule settings%2$s to manage pricing rules.
Pricing_Time_Dynamic: Time at which the dynamic price becomes active and starts being applied at checkout.
Pro_Feature_Requires: This feature requires FluentCart Pro v%s or later. Please update FluentCart Pro to use this feature.
Product_Account_Cannot: Your account cannot manage FluentPlayer videos. Ask an administrator to grant the FluentPlayer authoring capability.
Product_Attach_Wordpress: Attach the WordPress-supported digital files that customers will receive after purchasing this product. If this downloadable file is only for a specific product variation (e.g., 'eBook Version' or 'Audiobook Version'), please select that variant. Otherwise, you may leave the 'Choose variant' field empty to make the file available for all variants of this product. Please note that any additional files added after any sell will be accessible to both existing and new orders.
Product_Control_Available: Control available upgrade options and offer tailored discounts when moving between plans.
Product_Customize_Product: Customize the product's URL ending. Remember, this will affect SEO and readability. The URL will be activated when publish. Check Google's %s Structure Best Practices.
Product_Enable_Inventory: Enable inventory to track stock and manage availability for this product and its variations.
Product_Enter_Number: Enter the number of days the free trial will last. The trial period cannot exceed 365 days.
Product_Fluentplayer_Ready: FluentPlayer is ready. Save any changes to this product, then reload the page to add videos.
Product_Note_Private: Note: Private products are only visible to administrators but can be purchased via direct purchase link.
Product_Options_Create: These options would create variant identifiers longer than %1$s characters. Use fewer attribute groups.
Product_Organize_Product: Organize product variations by repeat interval (Monthly, Yearly) or payment term (One time, Subscription).
Product_Product_Currently: This product is currently in draft and cannot be sold to customers. Please publish the product to make it available for purchase.
Product_Select_Default: Select the default variant that users will see pre-selected on the product page.
Product_Set_Higher: Set a higher price to show with a strike-through, highlighting a discount for sales
Product_Set_Time: Set the one-time setup fee amount (e.g., $50) per order. This fee does not apply to quantity.
Product_Shipping_Class: Use a shipping class to group products with similar shipping requirements. This allows you to set specific shipping rates for different types of items, such as 'Bulky Items', 'Fragile Goods'. Select an existing class from the search box or click + Add to create a new one. If no class is assigned, the product will use your store's default shipping rates.
Product_Status_Controls: Status controls the product's visibility on the public page and its purchasability. 'Publish' indicates that it is live and can be purchased, 'Draft' signifies that it is in private editing, and 'Schedule' means it will be publish on a specified date. 'Private' means,  Only visible to adminstrators but can be purchased via direct purchase link. The status can only be changed once pricing is set.
Product_Switching_Advanced: Switching to Advanced Variations will delete all current variations for this product and cannot be undone. You won't be able to switch back to Simple Variations.
Product_Switching_Simple: Switching to 'Simple' will permanently delete all variations except the first one, along with any image attached to that variation.
Product_Switching_Simple_Permanently: Switching to 'Simple' will permanently delete the image attached to this variation.
Product_Title_Poster: Title and poster are sourced from YouTube, Vimeo, audio or HLS file or direct video
Product_Too_Many: Too many combinations (%1$s). Maximum allowed is %2$s. Remove some option values.
Product_Upgrade_Paths: Upgrade paths feature is temporarily disabled for bundle products. This feature will be enabled in a future update.
ProductRpt_Customers_Paid: What customers paid for products in this period, less refunds and tax. Shipping is not included.
ProductRpt_Net_Sales: Net sales are what customers paid, less refunds and tax. Expand a row for its variants; click a name for details.
ProductRpt_Open_Product: Open any product to see its sales over time, each variation's share, refunds, renewals and what customers buy with it.
ProductRpt_Put_Six: Put up to six products or variations next to each other and see which one sells, keeps and refunds best.
RefundRpt_Median_Number: Median number of days from an order to its first refund, for orders first refunded in this period.
RefundRpt_Money_Refunded: Money refunded during this period, tax included, whenever the order was placed. The Revenue page counts refunds on orders placed in the period, before tax.
RefundRpt_Refunded_Amount: The refunded amount in this period, split three ways. Each split adds up to the Refunded card.
RefundRpt_See_Many: See how many weeks after the order each refund came, to set a fair refund window and spot products that disappoint early.
RefundRpt_See_Products: See which products get refunded most, how much they cost you and their refund rate.
RefundRpt_Share_Period: The share of this period's orders refunded in part or full so far, as on the Orders, Payment Methods and Locations reports. The second line counts refunds made in this period per order placed in it, as the chart does; it can pass 100% when older orders are refunded.
Report_Every_Sale: Every sale and refund with its tax line, currency and exchange rates, for your accounting or tax software.
Report_Refunds_Negative: Refunds are negative rows; their tax is estimated in proportion to the order and marked in the Tax estimated column. ECB rates are units of the order currency per 1 EUR, for the transaction date and the last day of its quarter.
Report_Report_Needs: This report needs a newer FluentCart Pro. Ask a site administrator to update FluentCart Pro.
RevenueRpt_Gross_Sales: Gross sales less discounts and refunds. Shipping, fees and tax are not part of it.
RevenueRpt_Product_Sales: Product sales before discounts, refunds, shipping and tax, on paid, partially paid and refunded orders created in this period.
RevenueRpt_Refunds_Orders: Refunds on orders placed in this period, whenever they were refunded, without the tax, shipping and fees refunded with them (those leave their own lines). The Refunds page counts money refunded during the period, all of it.
RevenueRpt_Tax_Collected: Tax collected on these orders, including tax on shipping, less the tax share of refunds.
RevenueRpt_Time_Orders: One-time orders, new subscriptions, renewals, installment sign-ups and installment payments. The rows add up to net sales.
Review_Short_Review: A short review on WordPress.org helps other store owners decide, and tells us what to improve.
Review_Sure_Want: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this review? This action cannot be undone.
S3_Needs_Reconfigured: S3 needs to be reconfigured. Please go to S3 settings and re-save your bucket selection.
Search_Note_Plain: Note: For plain text searches, simply type your query without operators. The system will search across all text fields.
Session_Session_Expired: Your session has expired due to inactivity. Please refresh the page to continue.
Settings_Add_Margin: Add a margin of %1$s to fetched rates, to cover the spread your payment gateway charges on conversion.
Settings_Configure_Zugferd: Configure ZUGFeRD / Factur-X e-invoice encoding and seller details for your PDFs.
Settings_Customize_Pdf: Customize PDF templates for email attachments. Select which template to attach in each email notification's settings.
Settings_Design_Beautiful: Design beautiful email templates with a drag-and-drop block editor, shortcodes, and conditional content.
Settings_Edit_Rate: Edit each rate in the Currencies table below. Rates only change when you edit them.
Settings_Email_Footer:
This email footer will be used for all emails sent from FluentCart, It's highly recommended to use your business name and address in the footer for
compliance.
Settings_Keep_Converted: Keep converted prices at the previous rate for up to %1$s minutes after a rate change. Set 0 to use a new rate at once.
Settings_Makes_Prices: Makes prices end in .99 or .95, which shoppers tend to see as a better deal. It takes 0.01 or 0.05 off the rounded price, so pair it with a whole-number rounding step. For example, 92.00 becomes 91.99.
Settings_Multi_Currency: Multi-currency is in beta. Test it on a staging site before relying on it in your live store, and report any issues you find to %1$s.
Settings_Multi_Currency_Off: Multi-currency is off. Shoppers only see %1$s. Turn it on to add currencies and set their rates.
Settings_Multi_Currency_Settings: The multi-currency settings could not be loaded, so they cannot be changed right now.
Settings_Notification_Trigger: This notification trigger is controlled from the Reminders section. You can configure it from
Settings_Pdf_Receipt: To use PDF receipt templates, you need to install and activate the Fluent PDF plugin.
Settings_Preview_Shown: The preview shown here use sample data. Actual emails will be populated with real information.
Settings_Preview_Shown_Uses: The preview shown here uses sample data. Actual emails will be populated with real information.
Settings_Prices_Kept: Prices are kept in the base currency and converted at the rate you set. Each order keeps the rate it was placed at, and renewals keep it too.
Settings_Provide_Valid:
Provide Valid Email Address email as per your domain/SMTP settings. This
email will be used to send emails like notifications
Settings_Publish_Reviews: Publish reviews with photos immediately. When off, photo reviews always wait for moderation.
Settings_Raises_Lowers: Raises or lowers every %1$s price by this percentage after conversion. Use a negative number for a discount.
Settings_Rate_Saved: The rate is saved, but %1$s is not added to your currencies yet. Click Save Settings to keep it.
Settings_Remove_Shoppers: Remove %1$s? Shoppers can no longer pick it. Existing orders keep their currency. This applies when you save.
Settings_Rounds_Converted: Rounds the converted price up to the step you pick. For example, Round up to 1 turns 91.20 into 92.00.
Settings_Sell_Currency: Sell in more than one currency with exchange rates, price adjustments, rounding and charm pricing.
Settings_Set_Name: Set your from name, email, and email footer. These configurations will be used to send emails from %s.
Settings_Shoppers_Switch: Shoppers switch currency with the currency switcher. Add it to your header, footer or shop page with %1$s or the Currency Switcher block. For a navigation menu, add the class %2$s
Settings_Shortcodes_Blocks: Shortcodes/Blocks shown here use sample data. Actual emails will be populated with real information.
Settings_Some_Rates: Some rates have not updated for more than 3 days. Prices keep using the last rate until the next update.
Settings_Someone_Replies:
If someone replies to your notification email, this is where you would like to
receive it.
Settings_System_Email: A system email summarising your store activity. Numbers match the Reports dashboard.
Settings_Thank_Page: Thank you page Instruction will be displayed on the thank you page receipt section.
Ship_Calculate_Rates: Used to calculate rates at checkout and pre-selected when assigning packages to products
Ship_Check_Box: Check this box if you want the Cost to be multiplied by the quantity of items in the cart that belong to this shipping class. For example, if the cost is $5 and a customer buys 3 items from this class, the total shipping cost for these items will be $15, plus other shipping cost from other settings. Leave this unchecked to apply the cost only once per order for this class
Ship_Enter_Shipping: Enter the shipping cost for this class. This cost will be added to the shipping rate for products that belong to this class. Leave it at 0 if this class has no additional cost or if the cost is determined by other settings.
Ship_Give_Shipping: Give the shipping class a friendly name to help identify it when setting up shipping rates for your products. For instance: Bulky Items, Fragile Goods, and so on.
Ship_Packages_Defined: No packages defined yet. Add a package to define how your products are packaged for shipping.
Ship_Shipping_Methods: No shipping methods found for this zone. Add a shipping method to define how products are shipped in this zone.
Ship_Shipping_Zones: Shipping zones are now part of the Manual carrier. Add, edit and order your zones there.
Ship_Tracking_Number: Use {tracking_number} as a placeholder. e.g. https://track.dhl.com/{tracking_number}
SourceRpt_Add_None: Add a (none) row for orders without this source data, so the table adds up to Revenue for the same filters.
SourceRpt_Channel_New: What each channel's new customers spent first and have spent since, and how many came back.
SourceRpt_Group_Orders: Group orders into your own channels by UTM source, medium, campaign or referring site, and mark your own domains as direct.
SourceRpt_New_Customer: Each new customer's first purchase, by where it came from: your channel rules first, then its UTM tags, then the website that sent it.
SourceRpt_Spellings_Differ: Spellings that differ only in case, "_", "-" or spaces count as one. Lifetime Value adds later payments (renewals of these first orders, any date) to the first-order net.
Sub_Attempt_Failed: Attempt %1$s of %2$s failed: %3$s — no further automatic retries, the customer must pay manually.
Sub_Create_Next: Create the next renewal and charge it now? One attempt runs immediately; a decline falls back to automatic retries.
Sub_Proves_Exists: This only proves the ID exists in the connected gateway account. Confirm it is the right customer before saving.
Sub_Renewal_Charge: The renewal charge was submitted and is awaiting confirmation from the payment provider.
Sub_Renewals_Cancellations: Renewals, cancellations and incoming gateway webhooks all follow these IDs. Changing them does not change anything at the payment gateway — use this only to correct IDs that are already wrong.
Sub_Skip_Next: Skip the next billing period? The following renewal order will be created around %1$s.
Sub_Skip_Next_Billing: Skip the next billing period? The next_billing_date will advance one interval into the future.
Sub_Sure_Want: Are you sure you want to change the vendor IDs? Future renewals and gateway webhooks will use the new IDs.
Sub_Sure_Want_Update: Are you sure you want to update this subscription? This will affect all future renewals.
SubMode_Affects_New: Only affects new subscriptions. Existing ones keep their current billing method.
SubMode_Gateways_Without: Gateways without built-in recurring billing (SSLCommerz, Authorize.Net, bank transfer, etc.) can still sell subscriptions. Their renewals are invoiced by email before each due date.
SubMode_Gateways_Without_Built: Gateways without built-in recurring billing can still sell subscriptions. Their renewals are invoiced by email before each due date.
SubMode_Store_Creates: Your store creates a renewal invoice before each due date. Customers pay via a link in the email.
SubMode_Store_Creates_Renewal: Your store creates renewal invoices and charges saved payment methods automatically.
SubMode_Store_Creates_Renewal_Invoices: Your store creates renewal invoices before each due date. Customers pay via email link.
SubMode_Stripe_Paypal: Stripe, PayPal, and other subscription-ready gateways charge customers automatically each cycle.
SubMode_Stripe_Paypal_Subscription: Stripe, PayPal, and other subscription-ready gateways charge renewals automatically.
SubMode_Supported_Customer: When supported, the customer's saved payment method is charged automatically on each renewal due date.
SubRpt_Average_Cohort: The average cohort: the share of its customers still subscribed after each period, weighted by cohort size.
SubRpt_Average_Cohort_Share: The average cohort: the share of its starting MRR still coming in after each period, weighted by cohort size. It passes 100% when customers upgrade.
SubRpt_Average_Revenue: Average revenue per paying subscription: MRR divided by the subscriptions that pay more than 0. A discounted first year paid at 0 is left out.
SubRpt_Canceled_Subscriptions: Canceled subscriptions still in their paid term that end inside the horizon: the renewals they would have paid, unless the customer comes back.
SubRpt_Cohort_Data: Cohort data was last generated on %1$s. Generate it again to include the latest subscriptions.
SubRpt_Compare_Installment: Compare installment prices by plans started, money collected, payments still scheduled and plans that lapse.
SubRpt_Completed_Plans: Completed plans out of plans that have ended (completed, lapsed or refunded). Running and overdue plans are left out.
SubRpt_Customer_Whose: A customer whose subscription ended and who bought the same product again within 30 days of its paid term end counts as kept the whole time, not as one who left and came back. Use it when customers cancel and rebuy to get a new-customer price.
SubRpt_Every_Renewal: Every renewal due in the horizon, if every customer renews. Canceled subscriptions are not included.
SubRpt_Full_Month: No full month in this range yet. Pick a range that covers at least one past month.
SubRpt_Full_Year: No full year in this range yet. Pick a range that covers at least one past year.
SubRpt_Ideal_Amount: The ideal amount less the projected one: what you are not expected to collect at these rates, the room a win-back or dunning effort has.
SubRpt_Ideal_Amount_Renewal: The ideal amount at the renewal rates below. They start at your store's own rates from the last 12 closed months; move the sliders to try other rates.
SubRpt_Includes_Started: Includes %1$s that started and ended in this period; the Retention page leaves these out.
SubRpt_Monthly_Recurring: Monthly recurring revenue now: active subscriptions at their renewal price, plus discounted first years at the price paid now, plus canceled subscriptions until their paid term ends. Installment plans, trials, failing and paused subscriptions are not included. The date range does not apply.
SubRpt_Monthly_Recurring_Revenue: Of the monthly recurring revenue at the start of the period, the share kept at its end. New subscriptions are not counted.
SubRpt_Mrr_Canceled: MRR of canceled subscriptions still in their paid term. In MRR until the term ends; it leaves then unless the customer comes back. Subscriptions: %1$s.
SubRpt_Mrr_New: MRR of new subscriptions less MRR of churned ones, plus plan upgrades less downgrades. An upgrade is no churn and no new subscription.
SubRpt_Mrr_Subscriptions: MRR from subscriptions in a discounted first cycle, at the price paid now. Subscriptions: %1$s.
SubRpt_Mrr_Subscriptions_Whose: MRR of subscriptions whose renewal payment failed. Not in MRR. Subscriptions: %1$s.
SubRpt_New_Subscriptions: New subscriptions and churned ones per period, and the net change. In MRR, plan upgrades and downgrades too. Installment plans are not included.
SubRpt_Paid_Started: Paid on started plans, net of refunds. When an order holds a plan and other items, the plan's share of that order's tax, shipping and refunds is estimated by line amount.
SubRpt_Paid_Subscription: Paid subscription renewals in this period. Installment payments are not counted.
SubRpt_Payments_Left: Payments left on active and overdue plans. Projected applies the collection rate.
SubRpt_Plan_Ended: No plan has ended yet, so the rate starts at 100%. Move the slider to try other rates.
SubRpt_Rebuilds_Cohort: This rebuilds the cohort data from all subscriptions. It can take a minute on a large store.
SubRpt_Recurring_Subscriptions: Recurring subscriptions that ended in this period: canceled, expired, failing, past due or paused. The same rule as the Retention page.
SubRpt_Recurring_Subscriptions_Started: Recurring subscriptions started in this period. A free trial counts when it first pays.
SubRpt_Renewal_Plans: No renewal of these plans was due in the last 12 closed months; starts at the store's overall rate.
SubRpt_Renewals_Already: Renewals already due and not paid: in payment retry (failing or past due), or overdue. Not in the forecast; they may still come in.
SubRpt_Renewals_Fell: Of the renewals that fell due in the period, the share that was paid. A plan canceled early counts as a lost renewal when its paid term ends. Renewals still retrying payment count once they settle.
SubRpt_Renewals_Scheduled: Renewals scheduled by your live recurring subscriptions in the horizon, at their renewal price, by the month they fall due. Installment plans are not included; see the Installments report. %1$s
SubRpt_Retention_Compares: Retention compares the subscriptions active when a period began with those still active at its end. New subscriptions are not counted. Installment plans are not included.
SubRpt_Row_Customers: Each row is the customers who first paid in that month or year. Each column shows how many of them still had a running subscription after that many months or years. A customer who leaves and comes back counts again. Installment plans are not included.
SubRpt_Scheduled_Overdue: Scheduled and overdue payments at the collection rate set on the Monthly Schedule.
SubRpt_See_Let: See who let a subscription end and bought the same product again soon after, often to get a new-customer price.
SubRpt_See_Payments: See the payments due each month, project them at your own collection rate, and track how each month's new plans stand today.
SubRpt_See_Renewals: See renewals paid against renewals lost each period, and the expected lifetime and lifetime value of a subscriber.
SubRpt_Share_Renewals: The share of renewals you expect to be paid, per billing interval. The defaults are your store's renewals paid of those due in the last 12 closed months, as on the Retention page. A subscription's second renewal in the horizon counts only if it paid the first, so the rate compounds.
SubRpt_Split_Forecast: Split the forecast by product and variant, to see which plans carry your recurring revenue.
SubRpt_Split_Mrr: Split MRR by plan and by billing interval, and see how many trials turn into paying subscriptions.
SubRpt_Starts_Store: Starts at your store's rate: ended plans paid %1$s of their payments after the first. Move the slider to try other rates.
SubRpt_Subscriptions_Active: %1$s of the %2$s subscriptions active when %3$s began were still active at its end.
SubRpt_Subscriptions_Active_Period: Of the subscriptions active when the period began, the share still active at its end. New subscriptions are not counted.
SubRpt_Switch_Cohorts: Switch cohorts to MRR, read each billing interval apart, see the average retention curve, and count customers who cancel and rebuy as kept.
Tax_Applies_Micro: Applies to micro-businesses located in one EU country and making less than €10,000 in sales to other EU countries each year
Tax_Collecting_Cross: Collecting cross-border EU VAT at your %1$s home country rate. This is for small businesses whose total cross-border EU sales stay below €10,000/year. Once you exceed that threshold you must charge each buyer's local VAT rate instead.
Tax_Collecting_Vat: Collecting VAT across the EU using your %1$s home country rate. This rate applies to all cross-border EU sales.
Tax_Don_Select: If you don't select any country, all countries will be available for tax calculation. Are you sure you want to proceed?
Tax_Enabled_Apply: If enabled, apply reverse charge when applicable even when customers are in your home country.
Tax_Haven_Added: You haven't added a home country registration. The information you add here will be used to create one for you.
Tax_Home_Country: Your %1$s home country VAT rate will apply to all EU cross-border sales. This is available for small businesses below €10,000/year in cross-border EU sales. Make sure %1$s is registered below with the correct rate.
Tax_Home_Country_Vat: Your home country VAT rate applies to all EU cross-border sales. Make sure %1$s is registered here with the correct rate.
Tax_Listed_Price: Listed price stays unchanged on reverse charge. Only the tax line is zeroed on the invoice.
Tax_Make_Sure: Make sure you've downloaded and saved the CSV file for your records before proceeding.
Tax_Overwrite_Destination: This will overwrite all EU destination country standard rates with preset defaults. Continue?
Tax_Permanently_Delete: This will permanently delete the "%1$s" tax class and all its rates across every country (not just EU). Products using this class will fall back to Standard. Continue?
Tax_Rates_Class: All rates for this class will be deleted. Products using it will default to Standard.
Tax_Rates_Pre: Rates are pre-filled for convenience and may not reflect current laws — verify with a tax advisor before going live. If you sell products taxed at different rates (e.g. food, books, digital goods), use the + button to add tax classes.
Tax_Register_Country: Register in each EU country where you are required to collect VAT. Manage your registrations in the country list below.
Tax_Set_Oss: Set up OSS, micro-business, or specific-country registrations to collect VAT across the EU.
Tax_Shipping_Tax: Shipping tax always follows the store-level tax mode (Included or Excluded). Product-specific tax settings do not apply to shipping.
Tax_Shown_Prices: Shown on prices where tax is excluded. Applies when product or store pricing is tax-exclusive.
Tax_Shown_Prices_Where: Shown on prices where tax is included. Applies when product or store pricing is tax-inclusive.
Tax_Sure_Want: Are you sure you want to stop collecting cross-border VAT? This will clear your OSS/home country registration.
Tax_Tax_Currently: Tax is currently disabled. Enable tax from the Tax Settings page to start collecting tax.
Tax_Vat_Countries: VAT for these EU countries is currently being collected using Collect VAT cross-border (OSS). Check the country list in the Collect VAT cross-border section.
Tax_Vat_Stripped: VAT is stripped from the price on reverse charge. Customer pays the net (ex-VAT) amount.
